recommended_approach: Basic single-emitter Mantaflow GAS fire/smoke setup: one Flow object for the candle flame inside a Gas Domain, rendered as a volume using the domain’s fire fields.

domain_fields.density: use for rendering/shading the gas concentration field

setup_requirements.domain_material: domain must have a material assigned for rendering

warnings: Flow objects must be contained within the Domain bounding box to affect the simulation.
The Domain must have a material assigned for rendering.
The Domain auto-creates some smoke when fire emission is used.
Smoke can accumulate and fill the whole domain; the available fire pattern library suggests a multi-flow setup with dissolve as a fix path.
alternative_approaches: Emitter Particle System for a lighter-weight or stylized candle flame pass (`settings.type = 'EMITTER'`, `count = 500`, `frame_start = 1`, `frame_end = 50`, `lifetime = 30`).
Multi-Flow Domain (GAS) for separate control of flame and smoke behavior, especially if smoke handling becomes the main issue.
Volume-shader-driven rendering workflow using Volume Components and Principled shader inputs instead of relying only on the default fluid look.
